note: Concept art for the lotus avatar plan (18 Oct 2026). Test-folder only; not part of the production asset list.

assets.subject: a single closed pink lotus bud rising from a small round lily pad
assets.details: Plump teardrop bud with soft pink petals tipped in deeper rose, a faint inner glow as if something is sleeping inside, one dewdrop on a petal. Cute and magical.

assets.subject: a fully open pink lotus flower on a round lily pad
assets.details: Soft blush-pink petals in three layers around a golden seed pod, gentle glow, a few floating sparkles.

assets.subject: a fully open purple lotus flower on a round lily pad
assets.details: Lavender-to-violet petals in three layers around a golden seed pod, a soft violet glow and small star sparkles.

assets.subject: a fully open blue lotus flower on a round lily pad
assets.details: Sky-blue to deep sapphire petals in three layers around a golden seed pod, shimmering water-ripple light and small droplet sparkles.

assets.subject: a fully open golden lotus flower on a round lily pad
assets.details: Radiant gold petals with a warm metallic sheen in three layers around a glowing seed pod, light rays and gold sparkles, the rarest and most precious version.

assets.subject: Lian, QuinTaste's mascot: a friendly lotus-bud spirit (not a human)
assets.details: A round pink lotus-bud body with two small leaf arms, big closed happy upturned-arc eyes, rosy cheeks, a tiny peach chef apron and a small green leaf sprout on top. Full body, standing, waving one leaf arm.

assets.subject: Wen, a fictional adult QuinTaste member in Adult form
assets.details: Adult proportions (head about one third of the figure, not chibi), friendly smile, short wavy dark hair, warm skin, a cream knit top with a peach apron. Head and shoulders, plain pose, facing the viewer, centred. Leave clear space above the head for a hat.

assets.subject: the same fictional member Wen in Mini style (a cute chibi art style of the same adult)
assets.details: Same short wavy dark hair, warm skin, cream knit top and peach apron as the Adult form; big round head about 60% of the figure, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, small open smile. Head and shoulders, facing the viewer, centred, clear space above the head.

assets.subject: a small pink lotus hair clip accessory
assets.details: A cute enamel-style pink lotus blossom clip with a tiny pearl centre.

assets.subject: a white chef hat with a small purple lotus emblem
assets.details: Soft puffy toque, folded band with an embroidered violet lotus badge.

assets.subject: a flowing light-blue silk scarf with a wave pattern
assets.details: Loosely knotted short scarf, sky-blue with white water-ripple pattern and a tiny lotus charm.

assets.subject: a delicate golden lotus crown halo
assets.details: A small floating ring of golden lotus petals with warm glow and sparkles, worn just above the head.

assets.subject: Dewdrop, a tiny round water-droplet sprite pet
assets.details: A clear pale-pink droplet creature with a happy face and a lotus-petal cap, bouncing.

assets.subject: Mochi, a small round cream bunny pet with lavender ears
assets.details: Soft mochi-like body, lavender inner ears, tiny violet lotus on its collar, sitting and smiling.

assets.subject: Ripple, a small sky-blue rabbit-like pet spirit
assets.details: A round fluffy bunny with soft sky-blue fur fading to white on the tummy, very long floppy ears tipped with tiny glossy water droplets, big happy closed eyes, rosy cheeks and a little white wave-pattern scarf. A few tiny bubbles float around it. Sitting and smiling. Clearly different from a plain cream bunny: blue, water-themed and fluffier.

assets.subject: Golden Dewdrop, a tiny round water-droplet sprite pet made of shimmering liquid gold
assets.details: The same character as Dewdrop: a plump teardrop-shaped droplet with a big happy face, rosy cheeks and a small lotus-petal cap, but golden: warm translucent gold with a metallic sheen, a soft inner glow, a few gold sparkles floating around it. Bouncing happily. Not a fish.
